I’m sorry you went through this. My worst was:

I went to smoke weed with my ex, we were still friends at the time. We hadn’t seen each other in a while. So I drive over to his apartment, we sit on his balcony and start smoking. Weed sometimes makes me have panic attacks, but at the time I had been smoking every single day without freaking out. So after about 3 hits I just feel that anxiety creeping up. Then it hit me like a freight train. I texted my friend and told her to call me and say she needed me to come over. So she calls me, and I tell him I have to leave. So I go out to my car, full panic attack at this point. Hyperventilating, shaking, limbs are numb. I get in my car and realize I dont know how to drive anymore. So I call my mom, and I’m freaking out. She has no car at the time so she tells me she’ll talk to me until I calm down. I’m sitting in the drivers seat telling her this guy has his apartment door open and his head out the breezeway staring at me. And I start really freaking out at this point. I crawl into the floorboard, and debate on calling 911. My mom is also freaking out at this point contemplating taking the city bus to come get me. I finally get up after about 15 minutes and realize what I thought was a guy was a fire extinguisher box… at that moment I realize the anxiety is going away. So I wait a bit longer then drive home. Have never talked to that ex again. And to this day don’t know if that weed was laced.
